criteria.text: User Action: Opens a housemate’s profile from the House tab. Expected System Behavior: A “Preferred chores” section lists the chores that housemate marked as preferred (see SCRUM-61), in alphabetical order. The section is view only.
User Action: Opens their own profile. Expected System Behavior: The “Preferred chores” section shows their own preferences with an “Edit preferences” link.
User Action: Clicks “Edit preferences.” Expected System Behavior: The chore preferences screen from SCRUM-61 opens. After saving, the profile shows the updated list.
System state: A housemate updates their preferences. Expected System Behavior: The change appears on their profile for all housemates.
System state: A preferred chore is deleted from the household. Expected System Behavior: It no longer appears in anyone’s preferred chores.
Error Condition: A housemate has no preferred chores. Message: “[Name] hasn’t picked any preferred chores yet.”
Error Condition: The user has no preferred chores on their own profile. Message: “You haven’t picked any preferred chores yet.” with a “Set preferences” link.
Error Condition: Preferences fail to load. Message: “We couldn’t load preferred chores. Please try again.” with a “Retry” button.
